typed_links.link: One rule governs the cycle's four merges: a dialogue or phase turn between the same participants in one continuous scene never carries a unit boundary. 008 absorbed retired row M8-1Sam-009 (the 2:14|2:15 phase shift inside the priests'-portion custom register) to become 2:12-2:17; 029 absorbed retired row M8-1Sam-030 (the 6:6|6:7 seam inside one consultation exchange, with 6:4's doubled vayomru disclosed as an internal Q&A turn) to become 6:2-6:9.
Same rule, the campaign's worked example: 045 absorbed retired row M8-1Sam-046 because 9:5|9:6 is a turn between Saul and his servant on one continuous errand; merged as 9:3-9:8.
Same rule at 12:3|12:4: 061 absorbed retired row M8-1Sam-062, whose acquittal response belonged inside the juridical exchange; merged as the covenant-lawsuit unit 12:1-12:5.

Limit of the rule: the 14:7|14:8 turn stands as a boundary because 14:8-14:10 (M8-1Sam-074) is a bounded sign-protocol speech with its own protasis-apodosis discourse frame; that merge was declined and 073 held at low confidence instead.
3:1 stands alone as durative notice; 3:2-3:10 takes the specific-night staging from its former opening.
6:1 remains as the seven-month duration notice; 6:2's summons-and-question frame moved into the consolidated consultation unit.

8:10, the report-frame discharge of 8:9's instruction, closes the request unit; the king's-rights catalogue opens at 8:11's fronted declaration (fronted-object + yiqqach at 8:11/13/14/16 and nowhere else).
11:4's weeping report closes the messenger scene; 11:5 opens on the chapter's only wehinneh presentative reintroducing Saul.
regnal_summary_notice is reserved for 13:1's true accession formula alone; 3:19-21's durative growth notice was retagged narrative_prose.
7:15-17's all-the-days judging circuit carries the same durative register and takes narrative_prose under the reservation (postcheck consistency directive).
14:52's war-summary durative was the row whose challenge established the reservation; retagged narrative_prose.

Spans mixing narration with oracle take a compound tag: 28:15-19 (about 4/5 oracle) set the standard as narrative_dialogue_and_prophetic_oracle; 15:10-12 (about 1/3 oracle) follows a fortiori as narrative_and_prophetic_oracle.

The book's genuine near-verbatim standard is the four-word inquiry formula vayish'al David bYHWH lemor at 23:2 and 30:8; the Ziphite betrayal reports 23:19 and 26:1 are a compressed restatement (six-word core), and both rows now disclose the distinction instead of claiming near-verbatim status.

28:1's muster formula vayiqbetzu Phelishtim et machanehem is resumed near-verbatim at 29:1 (with kol and Apheq added), a Wiederaufnahme bracket around the En-dor cutaway; the affected rows dual-cite both members so the resumption is disclosed wherever either edge is argued.
